place.name: Pasaje
place.description: Pasaje, also known as Pasaje de las Nieves, is an Ecuadorian city; the head of Pasaje Cantón, and the second biggest and second most populated city of the El Oro Province. It is located in the southern Coastal Region, seated in a vast plain between the Jubones river to the north and el Palenque to the south, at an altitude of 30 m (98 ft) above sea level and with a tropical climate of 25 °C (77 °F) on average.
